scope: Source review of adding per-user Draw, Magnifier, and Macros tabs and app-local muted text styling. No build, native, or visual acceptance is claimed here.

layout_correction_review.scope: Reviewed horizontal user-tab scrollbar reservation, selected-tab reveal on width changes and actual clicks, and narrow Macro Studio wrapping/grid layout. No business command paths changed in these diffs.
layout_correction_review.visual_or_native_acceptance: Pending independent UI acceptance; source review does not establish rendered-pixel behavior.

review_notes: Embedded tool tabs pass the selected roster index into their controller before rendering or dispatch; profile-draft writeback is bypassed for these tabs.

Annotation and magnifier acknowledge settings against the user stored with the pending command; selection refreshes the clear-key and region drafts. Macro commands carry their selected user, and its standalone picker is disabled while a command is pending.

The nine existing tabs and their guarded Ouroboros button/Script.observe path remain intact; three tabs are added using the same guarded pattern. Scroll areas have separate IDs for the embedded pages.

The weak-text override is local to the application and reads the active Ouroboros muted-foreground token after theme installation and theme changes; it does not alter the pinned dependency or disabled-widget styling.

The reviewed follow-up reserves a non-floating scrollbar strip for both user-tab rows, revealing the selected tab after viewport-width changes and scrolling to an actually clicked tab without changing the guarded action path.

Macro Studio's generator grid switches between paired and four-column layouts by available width, while timeline, click, playback, and action rows wrap on narrow windows; command values and dispatch guards are unchanged.

verification.source_comparison: Compared final files against runtime/per-user-tools-source-base snapshots after the parent reported format/Clippy freeze.
verification.producer_status: Not assessed by this review; the parent owns the active producer checks.

correction_note: Baseline hashes were recomputed from the source-base snapshots and confirmed to match the accepted compact-chrome producer manifest; reviewed-source hashes and findings are unchanged.
